Tem gente que gosta de chamar esse teste de MVP, mas eu gosto de chamar de teste a custo baixo mesmo.
title: Innovation ≠ technology; validate cheap before you scale capital, "tinta amarela."

text: **Turn the catastrophe into the next business.** *Worked example, the "Use Huck" disaster (about 2014; meusucesso, writing in September 2021, says "Há sete anos"):* a co-branded custom-tee venture with Luciano Huck accidentally published an adult-shirt artwork over a *child's* photo; *"Ela ficou vinte minutos no ar, mas quando tiramos já tinha se formado um tsunami de críticas"* [it was up for twenty minutes, but by the time we took it down a tsunami of criticism had formed] in the meusucesso account (his 2025 spoken retelling says "30 segundos" [30 seconds]; see *Provenance notes*), detonated a backlash, and effectively killed the partnership. In Marcas Rebeldes #01 (unofficial captions) he adds that the partner asked "quanto eu te devo?" and he answered that he owed nothing, only that they avoid layoffs and redeploy people and equipment, which became Reserva Inc. Instead of laying off the 30 people on it (*"Em qualquer companhia, elas seriam mandadas embora."*), Meisler repurposed the operation into a white-label T-shirt service for any content brand that wanted a shop, which grew to roughly **10× the original** (meusucesso, "Os erros e acertos").
quotes: Há sete anos
Ela ficou vinte minutos no ar, mas quando tiramos já tinha se formado um tsunami de críticas
quanto eu te devo?
Em qualquer companhia, elas seriam mandadas embora.
Os erros e acertos
title: Turn the catastrophe into the next business

text: **Win one tribe deeply (neighbor effect).** *"em um mundo polarizado, é mais valioso conquistar profundamente um grupo do que tentar agradar a todos"* (his reading of Jaguar's rebrand). Map influence networks ("quem influencia quem") instead of fighting bubbles head-on (blog, "A grama do vizinho...", December 2024).
quotes: em um mundo polarizado, é mais valioso conquistar profundamente um grupo do que tentar agradar a todos
quem influencia quem
A grama do vizinho...
title: Win one tribe deeply (neighbor effect)

text: **Differentiation over benchmarking: the "gráfico da diferença."** Chasing a competitor's benchmark caps you at *equal*, never better. *Worked examples:* borrowing Harvard's Youngme Moon ("Different"), he charts a brand's capabilities against a flat market benchmark; for Reserva he scores logistics 5, creation 10, e-commerce 8, and says rebel brands ignore what sits below the line, double down on the peak, and are then forced to lift the rest to serve the demand it creates: *"O mercado não consegue explicar o que é diferente. Então eles dão um nome pro que é diferente de rebelde."* [The market can't explain what is different, so it calls it rebel.] (Marcas Rebeldes #01, unofficial captions). In writing he names Nizan, Renata Vichy, Abilio Diniz, Luiza Helena Trajano, Jobs, Beyoncé, Bezos, Elon, Taylor Swift, and, in an August 2023 post written before the split, **"os Birmans"**, as people who "nunca se preocuparam mais com o que os outros estavam fazendo, do que com o que eles próprios poderiam fazer" (blog, "Seja você mesmo, mas nem sempre o mesmo").
quotes: gráfico da diferença.
O mercado não consegue explicar o que é diferente. Então eles dão um nome pro que é diferente de rebelde.
nunca se preocuparam mais com o que os outros estavam fazendo, do que com o que eles próprios poderiam fazer
Seja você mesmo, mas nem sempre o mesmo
title: Differentiation over benchmarking: the "gráfico da diferença."

text: **"Quatro olhos": watch the customer, not the rival.** The companion fable to the difference chart makes the same point through two lifelong-rival booksellers: the one who spent decades copying the other never accumulated the "four eyes" (his own attention *plus* the copier's) that customer-obsession generates, *"Eles sempre poderão copiar o que você já fez, mas jamais poderão copiar o que você irá fazer."*
quotes: Eles sempre poderão copiar o que você já fez, mas jamais poderão copiar o que você irá fazer.
title: "Quatro olhos": watch the customer, not the rival

text: **Finite game vs. infinite game (imported from Simon Sinek).** Companies playing a "finite game" optimize the quarter; "infinite" ones compete against themselves for a cause that never ends. *Worked examples, three separate applications over three years:* Pope Francis's 2013 answer to a Church identity crisis, *"Fé e peregrinação"*, read as an "infinite leader" move (blog, "O papa é pop," 2022); Nike's "Winning isn't for everyone" campaign and its ad-question *"Am I a Bad Person?"* as a brand willing to alienate to stay coherent (blog, "Ser diferente é ser de verdade," 2024); and a binary "infinite leader vs. finite leader" grid (delegation vs. centralization, purpose vs. profit-only) built explicitly off Sinek plus Jack Welch's self-description as a CVO, *"Chief Vassoura Officer"* [Chief Broom Officer] (blog, "Precisamos falar de Céline Dion," using Céline Dion's illness-defying resilience as the frame).
quotes: Fé e peregrinação
O papa é pop,
Winning isn't for everyone
Am I a Bad Person?
Ser diferente é ser de verdade,
infinite leader vs. finite leader
Chief Vassoura Officer
Precisamos falar de Céline Dion,
title: Finite game vs. infinite game (imported from Simon Sinek)

text: **Three phases of a Brazilian entrepreneurial cycle, and why founders become the bottleneck.** Phase 1: "você e teu sócio e Deus", door-to-door selling toward market fit. Phase 2: the founder must become a people-leader and encode knowledge into systems "sem engessar" the culture. Phase 3: *"Quando você foi bem sucedido nisso, o negócio cresceu, aí você começa a atrapalhar [...] a boca do funil é maior do que a que sai do outro lado e o pessoal engargala"* [you start getting in the way; the funnel's mouth outpaces what comes out the other end]. He frames his own 2024 exit as a self-diagnosed arrival at Phase 3, not a forced departure (TalksbyLeo #238).
quotes: você e teu sócio e Deus
Quando você foi bem sucedido nisso, o negócio cresceu, aí você começa a atrapalhar [...] a boca do funil é maior do que a que sai do outro lado e o pessoal engargala
title: Three phases of a Brazilian entrepreneurial cycle, and why founders become the bottleneck

text: **"Caminho longo porém curto"** [the long-but-short road]. A rabbi's parable: a traveler is offered a short-but-long road (fast start, impassable obstacle) or a long-but-short one (slow, but it actually arrives); Meisler uses it to argue Brazil's "jeitinho" culture is the short-but-long road. *Worked example:* his own 18-year, self-funded build of Reserva, *"Sem atalho. Sem jeitinho. Sem fórmula mágica [...] Isso é ter cabeça de dono, não de apostador"* [No shortcuts. No magic formula. That's an owner's mindset, not a gambler's], versus *"os gurus de internet que empacotam o caminho curto como se ele fosse possível. E não é."* [internet gurus who package the short road as if it were possible] (LinkedIn Pulse, "Você está escolhendo o caminho errado," 2026). Spoken, he is harsher: *"vendedor de ilusão, né, que fica vendendo conversinha para quem já tá desesperado. Isso aí é sacanagem, né? É um crime, né?"* [illusion sellers peddling patter to people who are already desperate; that is a scam, a crime] (TalksbyLeo #238, unofficial captions). This is the frame for his explicit disagreement with Beto Sicupira (see *Where they disagree*).
quotes: Caminho longo porém curto
Sem atalho. Sem jeitinho. Sem fórmula mágica [...] Isso é ter cabeça de dono, não de apostador
os gurus de internet que empacotam o caminho curto como se ele fosse possível. E não é.
Você está escolhendo o caminho errado,
vendedor de ilusão, né, que fica vendendo conversinha para quem já tá desesperado. Isso aí é sacanagem, né? É um crime, né?
title: "Caminho longo porém curto"

text: **"Roube um estilo de liderança": curate, don't reinvent.** He names eight borrowed leadership lessons rather than claiming originality: Jack Welch's CVO (remove obstacles); Abílio Diniz's proximity-to-the-customer over hierarchy; his self-described *"madrinha"* [godmother] **Luiza Helena Trajano**, *"As pessoas não esperam que você seja perfeito, elas esperam que você seja honesto [...] nunca tentou ser perfeita e sim sempre buscou aprender com os erros"*; ex-Renault/Nissan/Ghosn executive Nélio Bilate on processes that must stay adaptable; Patagonia's Yvon Chouinard on why-over-what; volleyball coach Bernardinho's humility to "change himself, not the team"; his father **Luiz Meisler**'s "forget the spreadsheet, go sell door to door with humility"; and Unilever's Paul Polman dropping quarterly guidance (shares fell 8% on the announcement, then rose "mais de 290%" during his tenure) (blog, "Roube um estilo de liderança").
quotes: Roube um estilo de liderança
As pessoas não esperam que você seja perfeito, elas esperam que você seja honesto [...] nunca tentou ser perfeita e sim sempre buscou aprender com os erros
change himself, not the team
forget the spreadsheet, go sell door to door with humility
mais de 290%
Roube um estilo de liderança
title: "Roube um estilo de liderança": curate, don't reinvent

text: **Company-as-bird / generational handoff, now with exit mechanics.** *"O empreendedor é como um pássaro: nasceu para voar..."* (blog, "Feliz Vida Nova!"). The mechanics behind that framing, in his own words: his father's warning that sellers who don't *understand* they sold "continuam querendo agir como donas" of a company that's no longer theirs; a self-described *"soube parar"* [we knew when to stop] read straight from football fandom ("você vê na bola é muito rápido você ver isso [...] o cara que sabe parar e o cara que não sabe parar"); and the line that closes the loop, *"Cumpri o ciclo"* (TalksbyLeo #238). Pairs with his exit pride at Sicomércio 2025: *"É muito raro um empreendedor que vive todas essas etapas e sai pela porta da frente."*
quotes: O empreendedor é como um pássaro: nasceu para voar...
Feliz Vida Nova!
continuam querendo agir como donas
você vê na bola é muito rápido você ver isso [...] o cara que sabe parar e o cara que não sabe parar
Cumpri o ciclo
É muito raro um empreendedor que vive todas essas etapas e sai pela porta da frente.
title: Company-as-bird / generational handoff, now with exit mechanics

text: **Daily operating system (102030 + MARTE).** Personal scaffolding: 10 min meditation / 20 pages / 30 min exercise; mornings for creative work; social-media blackout during work hours (blog, "O presente é o passado do futuro"). The personal-finitude version of the same instinct: *"Assumindo que possuo uma vida privilegiada [...] já vivi quase 50% do tempo que eu terei de vida"* and a proposed personal "north star objective" for *"LX" (life experience)*, on par with a business's CX (blog, "Pura vida").
quotes: O presente é o passado do futuro
Assumindo que possuo uma vida privilegiada [...] já vivi quase 50% do tempo que eu terei de vida
north star objective
title: Daily operating system (102030 + MARTE)

text: **The routine's failure mode, named.** *Worked example of the cost of ignoring it:* he names the pattern's failure directly, *"eu já tive cinco, seis burnouts na vida [...] eu tenho essa tendência, eu sou muito ansioso"* and, separately, years of avoidable fatigue from an undiagnosed vision problem he didn't fix out of vanity/neglect (TalksbyLeo #238, unofficial captions). Fit Talk #01 (FitFeed's podcast) is built around the same turn; the host's description says he talks about discipline, mental health and "o momento em que entendeu que o sucesso sem bem-estar cobra caro" [the moment he understood that success without well-being exacts a price] (host text, not his words). The antidote he offers: *"a humildade é uma plantinha que a gente tem que regar todos os dias"*, followed at once by the jab at founders who flaunt wealth (see *Don't brag online* under *Decision heuristics*).
quotes: eu já tive cinco, seis burnouts na vida [...] eu tenho essa tendência, eu sou muito ansioso
o momento em que entendeu que o sucesso sem bem-estar cobra caro
a humildade é uma plantinha que a gente tem que regar todos os dias
title: The routine's failure mode, named

text: **Brand-as-purpose ("marca com propósito") / 1P=5P.** The brand exists to advance a cause; the product funds and signals it. *Worked example:* after a 2014 trip to Pentecoste (Ceará), a young man told him *"Aqui na região nunca faltou escola, mas eu ia lá mesmo para comer"*, a *"surra moral"* [moral beating] that led to **Reserva 1p5p** (2016; each item funds five donated meals). NeoFeed puts the count at **100 million plates by August 2023** (20 million pieces sold); later counts run from "mais de 50 milhões" to "mais de 157 milhões de refeições" and do not reconcile (see *Provenance notes*); cite the specific source and date rather than averaging. He frames the private-sector role bluntly: *"Quando a iniciativa privada se coloca entre o problema e o cidadão, o bem prospera"* (Sicomércio 2025), and directly names the doctrine he's rejecting: see *Friedman* in *Where they disagree.*
quotes: marca com propósito
Aqui na região nunca faltou escola, mas eu ia lá mesmo para comer
mais de 50 milhões
mais de 157 milhões de refeições
Quando a iniciativa privada se coloca entre o problema e o cidadão, o bem prospera
title: Brand-as-purpose ("marca com propósito") / 1P=5P

text: **Cash-first sequencing: wholesale makes the cash, retail makes the margin.** Rule: a fashion brand should start in wholesale because stock is financed at high interest (his figures: about 15% in Brazil against 5% in the US) while the P&L looks healthy. *Worked example, his own start:* the spreadsheets said opening one store would break them (outsourced minimum runs of 200 to 300 pieces per item), so he and Fernando sold to multi-brand stores first (about 80 to 90 doors before the first Reserva store), financed stores from wholesale cash and ran weekly cash targets. A second case: FARM going abroad through Anthropologie and trade fairs before opening small stores, which he calls his best bet for "a primeira grande história da moda brasileira" (Café com Ferri; ROI Hunters #349; both unofficial captions). *"Varejo não quebra no derré, varejo quebra no caixa."* (ROI Hunters, caption wording).
quotes: a primeira grande história da moda brasileira
Varejo não quebra no derré, varejo quebra no caixa.
title: Cash-first sequencing: wholesale makes the cash, retail makes the margin

text: **Inverted pyramid: the salesperson is the real boss.** If the customer is the boss, the person closest to the customer is the most senior role. *"Temos que inverter essa pirâmide e criar a cultura de que quem toca a companhia é o vendedor, é ele quem é o verdadeiro chefe"* [We must invert this pyramid and build a culture in which the salesperson runs the company] (PANROTAS 2025, reporter-attributed). *Worked example:* the store programme *"Movendo o Céu e a Terra pelo cliente"* paid the top commission to *"quem entregasse a melhor história de encantamento pro cliente e não a maior venda"* [whoever delivered the best customer-delight story, not the biggest sale] (Futurum Talks #56, unofficial captions). In Excepcionais he adds that the creative director must listen to the salesperson.
quotes: Temos que inverter essa pirâmide e criar a cultura de que quem toca a companhia é o vendedor, é ele quem é o verdadeiro chefe
Movendo o Céu e a Terra pelo cliente
quem entregasse a melhor história de encantamento pro cliente e não a maior venda
title: Inverted pyramid: the salesperson is the real boss

text: **Training manuals as collective memory.** *"Na minha empresa, todos os manuais de treinamento são feitos com base no que todas as pessoas que passaram pela companhia fizeram. O jeito de entender evolui com o tempo. Experiência é gente"* [In my company all training manuals are built from what everyone who passed through the company did... Experience is people] (PANROTAS 2025, reporter-attributed). He later turned the same habit, writing case studies of books he read for his staff, into the format of the Manual de Donos newsletter (Futurum Talks, unofficial captions).
quotes: Na minha empresa, todos os manuais de treinamento são feitos com base no que todas as pessoas que passaram pela companhia fizeram. O jeito de entender evolui com o tempo. Experiência é gente
title: Training manuals as collective memory

text: **Seven-day relationship call, the Reservado bag, and the salesperson CRM.** A non-selling call a week after purchase ("Quem não é visto não é lembrado") brought the customer back, in his figures, with 97% probability within 30 days (Café com Ferri) or *"97,5%"* (Made in Brasil #174); the second purchase then "retains" the customer for 12 months (his rule, no data shown). *Worked examples:* a salesperson CRM ("AAL") that gives idle staff a call list, and "Reservado," a bag algorithmically composed (item count, top/bottom/accessory ratio, colours) and delivered home in 3 days, born from *"o cliente às vezes ele quer o produto, mas ele não consegue vir na loja"* [sometimes the customer wants the product but can't come to the store]. Claimed result: purchase frequency of almost six times a year against two for menswear. All self-reported, unofficial captions.
quotes: Quem não é visto não é lembrado
o cliente às vezes ele quer o produto, mas ele não consegue vir na loja
title: Seven-day relationship call, the Reservado bag, and the salesperson CRM

text: **Store as the cheapest acquisition channel; internet as the single stock and the retention layer.** *"o físico é a melhor ferramenta de aquisição de cliente do mundo nessa nova jornada de consumo"* [the physical store is the best customer-acquisition tool in the world] and *"As DNVBs elas dependem do maior intermediário do mundo, o Google."* (Made in Brasil #174, unofficial captions). His arithmetic: mall rent around 12% of revenue against 20 to 30% to Google and Meta. *Worked example:* Reserva waited until 2012 for e-commerce because it first needed one consolidated stock and a self-built warehouse system; on the day it went live, physical-store sales rose 25% from stock availability alone, with no digital marketing: *"a internet é o canal logístico. A internet são todas as lojas. A internet é a visão de estoque único."*
quotes: o físico é a melhor ferramenta de aquisição de cliente do mundo nessa nova jornada de consumo
As DNVBs elas dependem do maior intermediário do mundo, o Google.
a internet é o canal logístico. A internet são todas as lojas. A internet é a visão de estoque único.
title: Store as the cheapest acquisition channel; internet as the single stock and the retention layer

text: **"Somos Todos Vendedores."** Made in Brasil #174 gives 2024 revenue of about R$2B, of which 68% digital or digitally influenced, half of store-team commission earned online, and more than 2,500 salespeople trained as creators (editing, WhatsApp store, Instagram store); some sellers bill R$300,000 to R$400,000 a month without being in a store. *"Não existe o on e o off, existe o cliente e jornada."* [There is no online and offline, there is the customer and the journey.] Self-reported, unofficial captions.
quotes: Somos Todos Vendedores.
Não existe o on e o off, existe o cliente e jornada.
title: "Somos Todos Vendedores."

text: **Zona de potência (power zone) against the leader's benchmark.** *"Foca na zona de potência."* Owners fixate on gaps against the market leader, which shrinks their strengths; instead let strengths pull the weak side up. *Worked example, his own profile:* strong in communication and commercial, weak in financial management, managerial accounting and logistics, so he leaned on the first two. *"parar de olhar pro lado que um amiguinho é bom, porque seu amiguinho é bom não significa que você é bom"* (Futurum Talks #56, unofficial captions). Pairs with the *gráfico da diferença* above.
quotes: Foca na zona de potência.
parar de olhar pro lado que um amiguinho é bom, porque seu amiguinho é bom não significa que você é bom
title: Zona de potência (power zone) against the leader's benchmark

text: **Ego is the failure mode of brand consolidation.** *"O ego é a coisa mais destrutiva que o negócio pode ter."* (Café com Ferri, unofficial captions). In Futurum Talks he says consolidation *"normalmente dá errado nesse setor, porque é muito ego"* [usually goes wrong in this sector because there is so much ego], with each brand's creative director believing they are the protagonist, and sets Reserva's counter-design against it: the customer is king, expressed in a 30m² first store with cold beer, house cappuccino and candy at the register before those became trends (unofficial captions). This is his own frame for the Azzas period; Azzas has not endorsed it.
quotes: O ego é a coisa mais destrutiva que o negócio pode ter.
normalmente dá errado nesse setor, porque é muito ego
title: Ego is the failure mode of brand consolidation

text: **Logo as shield; when the core customer outgrows the brand, build a separate one (Oficina Reserva).** *"A logo é um escudo"* (Café com Ferri) and *"A iconografia ela funciona como um escudo medieval."* (Entusiasta): logos signal membership and compensate insecurity, and confident consumers drift to "unbranded." *Worked example:* Reserva's customers aged and needed the brand less. A rack of upscale basics (Peruvian Pima cotton) inside Reserva stores went unseen amid the iconography, and Fernando teased him for wasting time; Rony insisted on another environment, a corner at Shopping Leblon with half a dozen items, and *"a loja explodiu, já nasceu explodindo porque o cliente já tinha falado que ele queria aquilo"* [the store exploded, it was born exploding because the customer had already said they wanted it]. Decision rule: *"não necessariamente a tua bolha representa todos os clientes."* (unofficial captions).
quotes: A logo é um escudo
A iconografia ela funciona como um escudo medieval.
a loja explodiu, já nasceu explodindo porque o cliente já tinha falado que ele queria aquilo
não necessariamente a tua bolha representa todos os clientes.
title: Logo as shield; when the core customer outgrows the brand, build a separate one (Oficina Reserva)

text: **Scarcity before purchase, love after.** *"Antes de você virar cliente, ela vem da escassez. Depois que você vira cliente, ela vem do amor."* [Before you become a customer, it comes from scarcity; after, from love.] *Worked example:* *"Eu tenho uma capacidade de produção de 10 copos desse e eu tenho 100 pessoas querendo comprar esse copo. Quem eu vou privilegiar? Quem já comprou o meu copo antes"* [existing customers first]. Failure mode: a luxury brand that mistreats existing customers (he cites a friend's brand that required scheduling a call to repair a piece) (Entusiasta, unofficial captions).
quotes: Antes de você virar cliente, ela vem da escassez. Depois que você vira cliente, ela vem do amor.
Eu tenho uma capacidade de produção de 10 copos desse e eu tenho 100 pessoas querendo comprar esse copo. Quem eu vou privilegiar? Quem já comprou o meu copo antes
title: Scarcity before purchase, love after

text: **Experience that outruns the price.** The business he looks for is *"Um negócio que tem uma experiência muito maior do que o valor real"* [a business whose experience is much greater than its real value], so any price feels reasonable, and *"A experiência é o produto e o produto é a experiência."* Companion rule from the book "Peak": do the basics before customization, since offering custom clothing is pointless in a store with no air conditioning (Entusiasta; Made in Brasil #174, unofficial captions).
quotes: Um negócio que tem uma experiência muito maior do que o valor real
A experiência é o produto e o produto é a experiência.
title: Experience that outruns the price

text: **Brand is built in time: the camel, not the unicorn.** *"Eu prefiro correr maratona do que ser 100 m rasos."* [I prefer to run a marathon than be a 100-metre sprinter.] and *"O camelo ele vai devagar, mas cara, ele não vai sentir sede não, velho."* (Made in Brasil #174). *Worked example, his reading:* Hermès overtook Louis Vuitton in market value (his figures, EUR 250B against 246B) by staying with quality, vertical production, scarcity and about 6 to 7% annual growth. In Startups podcast he adds that a Hermès bag at R$300,000 could not be sold at Zara, and that brand is built over time with "variáveis nativas humanas" (palate, smell, sight), which is why he argues taste cannot be fabricated by AI (unofficial captions; asserted, not evidenced).
quotes: Eu prefiro correr maratona do que ser 100 m rasos.
O camelo ele vai devagar, mas cara, ele não vai sentir sede não, velho.
variáveis nativas humanas
title: Brand is built in time: the camel, not the unicorn

text: **Personal brand as algorithm arbitrage.** The platforms monetize company ad accounts, so a company page pays to be seen while a founder's profile gets organic reach: *"eu preciso ter o Rone porque eu vou gastar menos dinheiro para ter mais divulgação"* [I need to have Rony because I will spend less money to get more reach] (Made in Brasil #174; a CEO colleague told him a CEO should not give opinions, and he did anyway). *"o futuro da marca pessoal ele é a comunidade"* [the future of the personal brand is the community] (Startups podcast). *"Eu não sou influenciador, eu sou empreendedor rodando a CP."* (Café com Ferri; the caption reads "CP," read here as ACP). Unofficial captions.
quotes: eu preciso ter o Rone porque eu vou gastar menos dinheiro para ter mais divulgação
o futuro da marca pessoal ele é a comunidade
Eu não sou influenciador, eu sou empreendedor rodando a CP.
title: Personal brand as algorithm arbitrage

text: **ACP as his own operating system after Azzas.** He posted about studies, tech and brand, trained his algorithm, and DMs became deals: a gym (The Simple Gym), a creatine brand, a personal-brand agency (Blank), the newsletter *"E-mail do Rony"* and the paid school Manual de Donos (R$197 a month; a case on Tuesday, an AI case on Thursday, one live class a month; text built to be read in 20 minutes). Claimed scale, in July 2026: *"mais de 2 milhões de assinantes"* with a 40% open rate (Café com Ferri) against 2.8 million in June (Futurum Talks), and *"6.000 alunos"* in 40 days. Newsletter origin: a pandemic WhatsApp link list, banned, moved to email in 2021. All self-reported, unofficial captions.
quotes: E-mail do Rony
mais de 2 milhões de assinantes
title: ACP as his own operating system after Azzas

text: **WhatsApp groups as the community layer (G200, G50, G100, G300).** A group of the 200 best repeat customers is asked questions (store decoration, collection theme, campaign face) and pruned yearly; B2B groups of 50, 100 and 300 get different content. *Worked example:* a Carnaval 2020 "contatinho" shirt printed on demand with each buyer's own Instagram handle sold about 10,000 in three or four days and, in his words, *"salvou a gente na pandemia"* [saved us in the pandemic] (ROI Hunters #349, unofficial captions).
quotes: salvou a gente na pandemia
title: WhatsApp groups as the community layer (G200, G50, G100, G300)

text: **ACP applied by a third party: Dane-se.** *"Ele partiu do mesmo funil que usamos na Reserva. Primeiro, criou audiência. Depois, a comunidade e, com ela, o produto"* and *"E quando for lançado, a incerteza é muito baixa, porque a própria comunidade desenvolveu e é consumidora do produto. E são milhares de pessoas."* (NeoFeed, Nov 2025). *Worked example:* founder Gregório Machado posted about a mineral water in a can he did not yet have, listed it for sale with orders auto-cancelled to test demand, grew from 60 thousand to almost 330 thousand followers, let the community vote flavours and design, and sold out a first lot of 3,000 cans in hours; the energy-drink launch on 18 November 2025 carried over 1 million cans (NeoFeed's reporting).
quotes: Ele partiu do mesmo funil que usamos na Reserva. Primeiro, criou audiência. Depois, a comunidade e, com ela, o produto
E quando for lançado, a incerteza é muito baixa, porque a própria comunidade desenvolveu e é consumidora do produto. E são milhares de pessoas.
title: ACP applied by a third party: Dane-se

text: **The prank that becomes a lead.** On 1 April 2024 Rony posted an ironic April Fools piece about "branding muito chato" in water brands, announcing his own "Mais uma água" (NeoFeed's words); Machado took it seriously and wrote to him, which started the Dane-se relationship. A second case is the Doing Nothing Club (next bullet). Pattern: his jokes seed audience and deals, which sits uneasily with the authenticity thesis (see *Blind spots*).
quotes: branding muito chato
Mais uma água
title: The prank that becomes a lead

text: **Doing Nothing Club and the shelf-gap test.** Flooded with what-will-you-do-next calls and, he says, nobody asking if he was fine, he decided *"Eu vou fingir que eu vou lançar um clube."* [I will pretend to launch a club.] and filmed a bathrobe launch video (TalksbyLeo #238, unofficial captions). He puts it at about 30,000 followers in a week; Exame, an outside account, called it an account created "numa mistura de provocação e autodeboche" with 16,000 followers in May 2025. The signal he read: a mental-health need, and a shelf gap (in his example, 70 natural-energy options at a US Whole Foods against three unhealthy ones in a Brazilian supermarket), the same logic as the five men in identical shorts. Rule: when you spot a gap while shopping abroad, test it.
quotes: Eu vou fingir que eu vou lançar um clube.
numa mistura de provocação e autodeboche
title: Doing Nothing Club and the shelf-gap test

text: **Rebels selection test: founders who don't need you, and construction, not hype.** *"A gente gosta, como investidores, de encontrar pessoas que não precisam da gente como investidor, que se sustentam sozinhas"* [As investors we like to find people who don't need us as investors, who sustain themselves] (Exame, Oct 2026). *Worked example, The Simple Gym:* *"A Simple tem caixa, tem lucro, tem fit com o mercado. Não é hype. É construção"*, positioned in a gap, *"Existe um buraco entre as academias populares e os clubes premium. E é nesse meio que a Simple se posiciona"*, by founders with *"um amor quase doentio pelo que fazem"* [an almost sick love for what they do] (Exame, May 2025). In his words the pull was the brand: *"A The Simple Gym chamou nossa atenção pelo Instagram... Mandamos direct e, de repente, estávamos conversando com os fundadores. Foi amor à primeira vista"* (Fitfeed, June 2025).
quotes: A gente gosta, como investidores, de encontrar pessoas que não precisam da gente como investidor, que se sustentam sozinhas
A Simple tem caixa, tem lucro, tem fit com o mercado. Não é hype. É construção
Existe um buraco entre as academias populares e os clubes premium. E é nesse meio que a Simple se posiciona
um amor quase doentio pelo que fazem
A The Simple Gym chamou nossa atenção pelo Instagram... Mandamos direct e, de repente, estávamos conversando com os fundadores. Foi amor à primeira vista
title: Rebels selection test: founders who don't need you, and construction, not hype

text: **Rebels' three values, used at the fork.** The first filter is an obsessive entrepreneur; the values test is three carried over from Reserva with the same partners: a dream that is "bom e grande," *"mente aberta"* (innovation's raw material is *audição*), and a commitment to people as much as results. Why only three: *"O valor serve na hora da bifurcação."* [Values serve at the fork in the road.] Lists of 10 or 15 get forgotten (TalksbyLeo #238). Partner choice is *"primeiro quem, depois como"* [first who, then how] (Marcas Rebeldes #01) and a marriage: "montanha, não é praia e montanha" (ROI Hunters #349). All unofficial captions.
quotes: bom e grande,
O valor serve na hora da bifurcação.
primeiro quem, depois como
montanha, não é praia e montanha
title: Rebels' three values, used at the fork

text: **Rebels' sourcing funnel and diligence rhythm.** He planned a vibe-coded landing page for 60 to 100 leads and received about 1,500 in May 2025; the partners split them and held six or seven 1 to 1.5 hour conversations a day for three to four months, transcribing every call into a vector-searchable "segundo cérebro do fundo" (TalksbyLeo #238). By his June 2026 count: *"a gente conversou com mais de 400 empresas nesse ano"* and *"a gente fez 10 negócios nesse ano"*, with a fifth partner, a 22-year-old named Michel (Entusiasta). Before investing the partners offer a three to six month mentorship; the launch coverage quotes *"Vamos investir em poucos, no máximo dez. Faremos uma mentoria de três a seis meses antes de decidir"* (Guia JeansWear). Unofficial captions except the last.
quotes: segundo cérebro do fundo
a gente conversou com mais de 400 empresas nesse ano
a gente fez 10 negócios nesse ano
Vamos investir em poucos, no máximo dez. Faremos uma mentoria de três a seis meses antes de decidir
title: Rebels' sourcing funnel and diligence rhythm

text: **Rebels' operating mode: copilot, quiet in the room, 20% adoption.** *"Somos copilotos. Não estamos aqui para mandar, mas para construir junto."* (Exame, May 2025; the page gives the line no speaker tag, but it follows a quote attributed to Meisler and a reporter's sentence, so read it as Rony speaking for Rebels, probably). In results meetings *"a gente vai ficar lá quietinho"* and gives feedback after; *"com muita sorte, em 20% dos casos que a gente opina eles escutam"* [with luck, in 20% of cases where we opine, they listen], which he calls *"monstruosamente alta"* (a high rate) because as an entrepreneur he would not have listened to three (Excepcionais, unofficial captions). The hiring lesson of the first operation: Gustavo Lerner, almost 25 years in Globo's commercial area, hired for revenue at Canal Foco (Exame, Oct 2026).
quotes: Somos copilotos. Não estamos aqui para mandar, mas para construir junto.
a gente vai ficar lá quietinho
com muita sorte, em 20% dos casos que a gente opina eles escutam
title: Rebels' operating mode: copilot, quiet in the room, 20% adoption

text: **Rebels' economics and exit rule.** Club deal, own capital; in his July 2026 count: eight companies, R$78M invested ("100% grana própria"), portfolio valued at "100 a 120 milhões," mainly purchase options plus some convertibles, a pipeline of 15 to 20, a bi-weekly investment committee and monthly results committee (Excepcionais, unofficial captions). *"E não temos prazo de saída. Se um dia isso acontecer, será com o empreendedor. Estamos juntos com eles. Na saúde e na doença. Na alegria e na tristeza."* (NeoFeed, Nov 2025). In Futurum Talks he adds a rule of thumb: enter up to about R$50M revenue, help the jump to R$200M to R$300M, then recommend a sale to a strategic or fund because Brazil's continental scale demands capital then; skin in the game means he backs only founders who already put their own money in (unofficial captions).
quotes: 100% grana própria
100 a 120 milhões,
E não temos prazo de saída. Se um dia isso acontecer, será com o empreendedor. Estamos juntos com eles. Na saúde e na doença. Na alegria e na tristeza.
title: Rebels' economics and exit rule

text: **Brand buys access: the Gooday case.** When Rebels came in (end of 2024 in ROI Hunters; Excepcionais ranks it second after Simple Gym), Rony told the founders *"esse negócio aqui tem mais marca que negócio"* [this business has more brand than business]: a year of consumer-brand firepower meant retail buyers already knew the name, so B2B would be easier by "10 degraus" (steps) instead of 100. Revenue as he gives it: about R$12M in 2024, about R$80M in 2025, and R$100M (ROI Hunters, May) then R$130 to 140M (Excepcionais, July/August) expected for 2026. On the deal itself: *"Não existe decisão nossa no nosso modelo de negócio, né?"* [There is no decision of ours in our business model.] Founder-reported, unofficial captions.
quotes: esse negócio aqui tem mais marca que negócio
Não existe decisão nossa no nosso modelo de negócio, né?
title: Brand buys access: the Gooday case

text: **Blank: sell distribution, and let the founders decide if you deserve equity.** Blank began as a certification info-product that "não vai escalar," pivoted to a personal-brand agency, and Rony became its pilot client. When its founders refused a new partner ("pacto de sangue"), he offered to be a paying client first: *"se der certo ... vocês me dizem se eu mereço ser sócio ou não"* [if it works, you tell me whether I deserve to be a partner] (TalksbyLeo #238). Claimed size drifts: 90 personal brands and R$10M with a R$30M target (ROI Hunters, May) against 80 and R$15M to R$20M heading to R$45M (TalksbyLeo, June). Unofficial captions, founder-reported.
quotes: não vai escalar,
pacto de sangue
se der certo ... vocês me dizem se eu mereço ser sócio ou não
title: Blank: sell distribution, and let the founders decide if you deserve equity

text: **Media thesis: own attention with a brand.** *"Quem tem atenção faz todo o resto"* [whoever has attention does everything else later] (Excepcionais, unofficial captions). In October 2026 Rebels put an undisclosed sum into Canal Foco, a YouTube entertainment channel created in 2023 with R$50,000 whose main format puts one person against thirty in a debate; Rony joined its panel on "Os Caras do Pix" before the deal, and the rationale is its own audience as a distribution channel for new products (Exame). Its CEO's targets (R$25M to 30M in advertising in 2027, R$100M in 2028) are the channel's, not verified.
quotes: Quem tem atenção faz todo o resto
Os Caras do Pix
title: Media thesis: own attention with a brand

text: **Selection by edge: Rebels is not a growth shop.** *"O meu modelo, o modelo de gestão que eu posso ajudar [...] não é growth, é que queima a caixa muitas vezes para crescer. [...] não é minha praia"* [the management model I can help with isn't growth, which often burns cash to grow; it isn't my thing] (TalksbyLeo #238), an explicit refusal to sell what he doesn't have; in Futurum Talks, *"eu não sei fazer essas teses malucas de growth, né? A, B, C, D."* and *"eu nunca verticalizei e nem pretendo verticalizar assim, porque eu acho que a indústria é um bicho totalmente diferente"* [I never verticalized and don't intend to, because industry is a totally different animal]. His zone is *"geração de valor, recriação de marca, é máquina de venda"* [value generation, brand recreation, a sales machine] (Startups.com.br summary). Unofficial captions where noted.
quotes: O meu modelo, o modelo de gestão que eu posso ajudar [...] não é growth, é que queima a caixa muitas vezes para crescer. [...] não é minha praia
eu não sei fazer essas teses malucas de growth, né? A, B, C, D.
eu nunca verticalizei e nem pretendo verticalizar assim, porque eu acho que a indústria é um bicho totalmente diferente
geração de valor, recriação de marca, é máquina de venda
title: Selection by edge: Rebels is not a growth shop

text: **Build vs buy, and example over advice.** A rule reported by the newsletter author: if more than 15 off-the-shelf solutions already do the function, buy rather than build (Micro-SaaS newsletter, a third-party summary; the "15" is the author's formulation). Two lines attributed to him: *"conselho é bom, exemplo arrasta"* and *"se ideia valesse alguma coisa, era vendida a 10 centavos o balde"* [if an idea were worth anything, it would be sold at ten cents a bucket] (same source), the first also in Made in Brasil #174 as *"Se o conselho é bom, exemplo arrasta"* (unofficial captions).
quotes: conselho é bom, exemplo arrasta
se ideia valesse alguma coisa, era vendida a 10 centavos o balde
Se o conselho é bom, exemplo arrasta
title: Build vs buy, and example over advice

text: **Owner mode vs executive mode (the Iguatemi protocol).** He sits on the Iguatemi board and describes the owners' arrangement: three siblings left operations, a career executive is CEO, the siblings form the board, and each Friday they spend two hours with the responsible operator on one demand tied to each sibling's specialty (capital structure, mall mix, commercial). *"Isso é dono."* [That is an owner.] An owner sets strategy, allocates capital, mentors people and lives on dividends; an executive runs the machine (ROI Hunters #349, unofficial captions).
quotes: Isso é dono.
title: Owner mode vs executive mode (the Iguatemi protocol)

text: **Founder mode, answered.** On Brian Chesky and "founder mode": *"Eu acho o Brian muito jovem."* and *"Eu acho que ele saiu no tempo errado."* (the company was too young and the step back weakened culture), but stepping back is justified once succession has produced a strong executive. His own lean is toward *"economia real"*: *"Eu sou um cara mais de economia real."* Elsewhere: *"Uma companhia tem que ter um dono, tem que ter alguém que decide."* (TalksbyLeo #238). Unofficial captions.
quotes: Eu acho o Brian muito jovem.
Eu acho que ele saiu no tempo errado.
Eu sou um cara mais de economia real.
Uma companhia tem que ter um dono, tem que ter alguém que decide.
title: Founder mode, answered

text: **Leading upward and founder-to-executive rules.** After the sale he treated it as a craft: know you no longer own it; *"liderar para cima"*; put up the *"arame farpado"* so the acquirer's culture does not touch the team; rotate the burden among the four partners (when one tired, another went to war); deliver numbers because results buy freedom (Futurum Talks). He renamed his own routines to match Azzas governance (weekly sales meeting "COMEX," monthly results "N1") while running them his own way, kept two-year plans because *"4 anos não existe"* and called the leader *"o algodão entre os cristais"* (Excepcionais). *"O empreendedor é um bicho. O executivo é um bicho totalmente diferente, velho."* (Futurum Talks). Unofficial captions.
quotes: liderar para cima
4 anos não existe
o algodão entre os cristais
O empreendedor é um bicho. O executivo é um bicho totalmente diferente, velho.
title: Leading upward and founder-to-executive rules

text: **Innovation is phases of a project, not a department.** *"A inovação não é uma área de negócio, a inovação são fases de um projeto."* and *"A dificuldade é quando um projeto de fase um é tratado como projeto de fase três."* [The difficulty is when a phase-one project is treated as a phase-three project.] Applied to his own intrapreneurship at Azzas. Also: *"uma empresa é tão somente a sua capacidade de comunicação"* and *"Processo é tubo de encanamento da onde passa informação"* [process is the plumbing through which information flows] (Powercast #248, unofficial captions).
quotes: A inovação não é uma área de negócio, a inovação são fases de um projeto.
A dificuldade é quando um projeto de fase um é tratado como projeto de fase três.
uma empresa é tão somente a sua capacidade de comunicação
Processo é tubo de encanamento da onde passa informação
title: Innovation is phases of a project, not a department

text: **Persistence versus stupidity.** *"Errar é humano, né? Insistir num erro é burrice."* [To err is human; persisting in an error is stupidity.] Budget a margin for innovation and error inside the plan, and stop before becoming *"comandante naufrágio"* (Futurum Talks #56, unofficial captions). Pairs with *"Não tem como inovar se não errar"* (PANROTAS 2025).
quotes: Errar é humano, né? Insistir num erro é burrice.
Não tem como inovar se não errar
title: Persistence versus stupidity

text: **Purpose welded to the payslip.** At Reserva the number of meals donated through 1P=5P appeared on each employee's pay stub: *"No contracheque do cara, vim a quantidade de refeição que o trabalho dele levou ele complementar."* (Startups podcast) and *"no contra-cheque da galera vem a quantidade de refeição per cápta"* (Excepcionais). His principle: *"agenda de sustentabilidade que é propulsora de valor é a que tá vinculada ao negócio"* [a sustainability agenda that drives value is the one tied to the business], because it creates belonging. Unofficial captions.
quotes: No contracheque do cara, vim a quantidade de refeição que o trabalho dele levou ele complementar.
no contra-cheque da galera vem a quantidade de refeição per cápta
agenda de sustentabilidade que é propulsora de valor é a que tá vinculada ao negócio
title: Purpose welded to the payslip

text: **1P=5P origin and best campaign.** Rony went to meet Blake Mycoskie of Toms because he wanted to launch something similar, which led to 1P=5P; *"a melhor campanha de comunicação, de marketing e de marca que a gente já fez na nossa história foi o lançamento de um P5P"* [the best communication, marketing and brand campaign we ever made was the launch of 1P=5P]: before it almost nobody wrote to him about purchases, afterwards he got dozens of messages a week from customers leaving five, ten or twenty plates (Marcas Rebeldes #01, unofficial captions). Meal counts differ by source (see *Provenance notes*).
quotes: a melhor campanha de comunicação, de marketing e de marca que a gente já fez na nossa história foi o lançamento de um P5P
title: 1P=5P origin and best campaign

text: **Brand elasticity (Virgin).** *"são marcas elásticas, né, maior parte dos casos, porque elas não estão muito preocupadas com as regras do jogo"* [they are elastic brands because they aren't much worried about the rules of the game], and *"Sir Richard Branson é, em minha opinião, o empreendedor rebelde mais admirável do mundo."* Branson licensing the Virgin brand into airlines, hotels and telephony as separate companies is, he says, what he dreams of having done with Reserva (Marcas Rebeldes #01, unofficial captions).
quotes: são marcas elásticas, né, maior parte dos casos, porque elas não estão muito preocupadas com as regras do jogo
Sir Richard Branson é, em minha opinião, o empreendedor rebelde mais admirável do mundo.
title: Brand elasticity (Virgin)

text: **Reserva Inc: a customer request becomes a platform.** A customer asked a store to print a T-shirt for his *chopada*; no fashion company offered it, so Reserva imported an Israeli textile printer, piloted with orders in a notebook, built a self-service online editor with 7-working-day delivery, then opened it as a platform: *"mais de 120.000 logistas na plataforma"* (Made in Brasil #174) against "mais de 120 lojistas" (Marcas Rebeldes #01); the first looks right. Lesson: *"o branding é o modelo de negócio no mundo que a gente vive"*; brainstorm business models, not only products. Unofficial captions, self-reported.
quotes: mais de 120.000 logistas na plataforma
mais de 120 lojistas
o branding é o modelo de negócio no mundo que a gente vive
title: Reserva Inc: a customer request becomes a platform

text: **Use one product to enter; do not communicate the whole range.** For a fashion founder: pick one hero product and communicate it ostensively until you are tired: *"quem tá cansado é você, não é o público"* [you are the one who is tired, not the public]. Reserva's counterexample: with 400 to 600 SKUs *"você tentava comunicar tudo, você não comunica nada"* (ROI Hunters #349, unofficial captions). In 2021 or 2022 it built its own YouTube channel "Geração R" with an unknown host and a survey-suggested humour format; "não foi."
quotes: quem tá cansado é você, não é o público
você tentava comunicar tudo, você não comunica nada
title: Use one product to enter; do not communicate the whole range

text: **Boring business plus a brand layer.** Menswear was a "boring business" lifted by brand and experience; Brazilian health and wellness is boring in its communication. He cites Codie Sanchez's roll-up playbook (buy cash-generating small businesses from retiring owners, put them under one brand) and adds a capital-structure twist: buy, then franchise to scale with less capital (ROI Hunters #349, unofficial captions; the roll-up references came up in the hosts' discussion).
title: Boring business plus a brand layer

text: **Plan the commercial calendar backwards.** In his claim 97% of Brazilian entrepreneurs do not plan one. Method: plan the tip of the iceberg (the sales peaks) and slice backwards through the supply chain; used in a Manual de Donos live class on a 2026 calendar crowded by the World Cup, elections and holidays (Startups podcast, unofficial captions).
title: Plan the commercial calendar backwards

text: **Zig when others zag, with diligence.** When everyone told him to launch mentoring, he chose a low-ticket paid newsletter: *"Tá todo mundo indo para um lugar. vai pro outro, não necessariamente porque o outro é um lugar maior, mas tá menos crowd"*, but *"Óbvio que você tem que ser diligente e pensar porque às vezes esse negócio é na morto, né?"*; low ticket was chosen because he wants a business that reaches millions: *"É melhor, mas não escala Brasil."* (ROI Hunters #349, on few clients paying a lot). Unofficial captions.
quotes: Tá todo mundo indo para um lugar. vai pro outro, não necessariamente porque o outro é um lugar maior, mas tá menos crowd
Óbvio que você tem que ser diligente e pensar porque às vezes esse negócio é na morto, né?
É melhor, mas não escala Brasil.
title: Zig when others zag, with diligence

text: **Manual de Donos and the four needs of the small owner.** Knowledge, credit, management technology and investment (Futurum Talks); *"o pequeno e médio empreendedor no Brasil tá exausto"* [the small and mid-sized entrepreneur in Brazil is exhausted] (ROI Hunters). He cites a Cabeça de Dono survey (Instituto Locomotiva with Itaú BBA, from his recall, not checked): over 40% exhausted, over 50% lonely, over 60% unable to do financial management, over 90% without quality family time (TalksbyLeo). The stated aim: *"a gente quer em 5 anos fazer 1 milhão de cabeças de donos"* (Startups podcast). A banking arm for entrepreneurs, with Stone, is the fourth piece (Powercast). Unofficial captions.
quotes: o pequeno e médio empreendedor no Brasil tá exausto
a gente quer em 5 anos fazer 1 milhão de cabeças de donos
title: Manual de Donos and the four needs of the small owner

text: **AI first by process, not by tool.** Map processes by repeated effort, need for a boss's approval and cost or time, automate the top cluster, then ask the model which tool. *"Pessoas pegam lá a senha da adapta, pô, distribuem pra companhia e acham que é a companhia AI driven. Assim, não tá tá com Google super turbinado."* (Café com Ferri). Personal case: his 10/20/30 routine plus an AI "coach chato" on WhatsApp at 7:10, which became the habit-coach product "Superdash": *"automatizando problemas da minha vida, eu criei soluções de negócio para os outros também"* (Made in Brasil #174). Why: *"Eu estudo porque eu tenho medo."* (Excepcionais). Unofficial captions.
quotes: Pessoas pegam lá a senha da adapta, pô, distribuem pra companhia e acham que é a companhia AI driven. Assim, não tá tá com Google super turbinado.
automatizando problemas da minha vida, eu criei soluções de negócio para os outros também
Eu estudo porque eu tenho medo.
title: AI first by process, not by tool

text: **The doorman fallacy and the premium on human service.** Borrowing Rory Sutherland: cutting the doorman to save salary removes the human experience that made the building feel like a hotel. His extension: as digital commerce automates, human service becomes scarce and priced higher (therapy with GPT against human therapists, whose average ticket "vai subir para caramba"); *"o in real life vai ser mais valorizado"*; Rebels therefore sees offline (the gym) as an investment area (Café com Ferri; Startups podcast, unofficial captions). A caution he gives to companies: be certain AI cannot do the job you are about to hire for (Powercast).
quotes: vai subir para caramba
o in real life vai ser mais valorizado
title: The doorman fallacy and the premium on human service

text: **AI slop and the community exit.** *"a gente tá vivendo o ano 26, ao meu ver, é o ano do AI Slop em termos de conteúdo na internet"* (Startups podcast). The escape is community and the right 10,000 people over reach (TalksbyLeo #238); *"A gente trabalha de graça para elas todos os dias."* on the social platforms (Startups podcast). Dated predictions, unofficial captions.
quotes: a gente tá vivendo o ano 26, ao meu ver, é o ano do AI Slop em termos de conteúdo na internet
A gente trabalha de graça para elas todos os dias.
title: AI slop and the community exit

text: **Fashion shows as parody.** At São Paulo Fashion Week Reserva mocked the establishment: costumes bought in Saara (Shrek, Flintstones, Mickey) hung in the photographers' pit with a handwritten note inviting the front row to take one home, because this is not a show, it is a costume. The press reaction was negative the next day; customers noticed. In 2009 an uninvited television prank on the runway (a Pânico "Impostor") was bet on by the founders as TV, and gave a no-name brand national airtime (Futurum Talks #56, unofficial captions; the 2009 episode is described by the hosts).
title: Fashion shows as parody

text: **Operating system updates.** *"eu acredito mais em sistema do que em meta"* [I believe more in systems than in goals] (Made in Brasil #174). Reading: *"eu leio quatro a cinco livros por mês desde que eu me conheço por gente"* (Startups podcast), two hours a day of phone use enforced with the app Opal, long-form content only. *"Humildade não é o exercício diário. Humildade é um exercício minutário, principalmente para nós empreendedores."* (Made in Brasil #174). Family pact: *"em quinto lugar o trabalho para dar orgulho pra família"* [fifth, work, to make the family proud] (Café com Ferri). Unofficial captions.
quotes: eu acredito mais em sistema do que em meta
eu leio quatro a cinco livros por mês desde que eu me conheço por gente
Humildade não é o exercício diário. Humildade é um exercício minutário, principalmente para nós empreendedores.
em quinto lugar o trabalho para dar orgulho pra família
title: Operating system updates

text: **Record the imperfect start.** Film sales calls, supplier talks, rejections and defects; vulnerability builds an audience so CAC becomes *"ou zero ou negativo"* (Powercast #248). The Marcas Rebeldes logo is a scribble: *"imperfeição é valor"* [imperfection is value] (Marcas Rebeldes #01). Family rituals as management: at Reserva conventions, spouses and children sat in the front row when staff were honoured and he addressed the children from the stage (Powercast). Unofficial captions.
quotes: ou zero ou negativo
imperfeição é valor
title: Record the imperfect start

text: **The spreadsheet confirms; the street decides (the first shorts).** At 23, still at Accenture and living with his parents, he and Fernando found a São Gonçalo factory through a CNPJ printed on a clothing label; asked for vector artwork, a spec sheet, Corel and Photoshop, they had none, so in the car they typed "Be Yourself" in Word (Arial) for the leg of the first shorts, a first order of about 300 pieces. Each put in R$3,000 (R$6,000 in total) and they became street peddlers. Their business-case spreadsheet projected a billion in revenue in three months (*"planilha papel e ouvido aceita tudo"* [spreadsheet, paper and ears accept anything]), his father told them to go out and sell, and its one real lesson was that opening a store first would break them on production minimums, so they started with multi-brand stores. The gym scene that started it: *"tinha uns cinco caras usando uma bermuda da mesma estampa mesma cor Idêntica"* (Os Sócios cut, unofficial captions).

text: **Pivot vs. persevere.** Persevere on the *brand/cause*, pivot the *vehicle*. The Use Huck failure was re-pointed into a white-label service that dwarfed the original deal. When a two-year fashion non-compete from the Azzas exit blocked him from re-entering apparel, he didn't fight the clause or wait it out, he pivoted Rebels Ventures entirely into wellness/longevity, a sector the non-compete didn't reach (NeoFeed, Rebels exclusive).
title: Pivot vs. persevere

text: **How to price / where margin lives.** Treat CX and customization as variable-cost margin levers (blog, "A ordem dos fatores...").
quotes: A ordem dos fatores...

text: **When to sell / exit.** Position: sell from strength, take governance seriously while you're in, and know the difference between *knowing* you sold and *understanding* you sold (his father's distinction). He sold a profitable, growing brand on a market-sizing argument, stayed four years, which he calls an "MBA" in running a public company, and left when his own three-phase model said he had become the bottleneck, with the health crisis as the forcing function. The deal terms, his reasons and the press account follow below.
title: When to sell / exit

text: **Raise vs. bootstrap.** Reserva ran on R$6,000 total invested capital, ever, and he describes it as profitable throughout: *"Fomos lucrativos em todos os 18 anos que estivemos à frente do negócio."* (LinkedIn Pulse, "Você está escolhendo o caminho errado," 2026), though a spoken account from the same year says *"foram 17 anos de lucro e caixa"* with a loss only in 2020, and a very small one (Powercast #248, unofficial captions; see *Provenance notes*). Rebels Ventures is capitalized the same way at the fund level: no outside LPs, a "club deal" where each partner sizes their own check per deal.
quotes: Fomos lucrativos em todos os 18 anos que estivemos à frente do negócio.

title: Raise vs. bootstrap

text: **Who to bring in as partners.** Explicitly modeled on 3G Capital's Beto Sicupira / Marcel Telles / Jorge Paulo Lemann, long-term, inseparable partnership as the template for both the original Reserva founding team and the four-person Rebels Ventures split (Rony = strategy/brand; Fernando Sigal = supply chain; Jayme Nigri Moszkowicz = operations; José Alberto Silva = digital).
title: Who to bring in as partners

text: **Focus vs. diversify.** Diversify *within* a coherent brand universe (Reserva Mini/Go/Ink, Eva, Oficina) rather than scattering; for the *country*, Brazilian brands must dominate the continental home market before going global (NeoFeed, global-brand piece).
title: Focus vs. diversify

text: **Founder vs. corporate-parent control.** His own case is the cautionary position, a creative, decentralizing founder under a centralizing controller is a structural mismatch: *"O estilo mais centralizador de Birman também bateu de frente com a personalidade de Rony"* (Exame). Complication: he says he *tried* to internalize his father's advice to respect the new owner's authority for four years before concluding the fit had run out, the friction wasn't instant refusal, it was a slow-building mismatch.

text: **Terms of the 2020 sale: governance before price, stock-linked consideration, no earn-out.** Preparing the IPO he read Chris Voss and treated the sale as a game. Conditions came first: staying in Rio with autonomy and governance meetings; *"se a gente não chegasse num acordo de como seria a nossa vida depois, não teria preço que pagasse"* [if we hadn't agreed how our life would be afterwards, no price would have paid]. He and the partners set a minimum price, and *"Eu vendi pelo dobro."* [I sold for double.] Payment was partly Arezzo shares: *"tudo cash out, né? Mas 20% à vista e os outros em lockups que terminavam só no final do quarto ano"* (Startups podcast); he chose not to have an earn-out (the caption garbles the word) and says the governance clauses effectively dissolve because you don't sue over governance contracts. *"O nosso salário não aumentou depois da venda."* (Excepcionais). Unofficial captions.

text: **Why he sold: pandemic liquidity, not a plan to exit.** Stores closed on 18 March 2020, with three months of cash for almost 3,000 people and a decision not to lay anyone off (*"A gente tomou decisão de não demitir."*); his leverage of about half an EBITDA turn turned from an advantage into a disadvantage; as a father of three, after being close to death by his account, he wanted some liquidity: *"tirar algumas fichas da mesa"* [take some chips off the table]. A syndicate bank pitched a fast track to the stock market through Arezzo. By 18 June 2020 sales were growing 20% with all stores closed, digital only: *"A gente pousou o avião no rio Hudson"* (Powercast #248; ROI Hunters #349; unofficial captions). The principle he states: *"Se você construir uma empresa assim, e caso apareça alguém querendo comprar ela, ela vai valer mais."* [Build a company you'd enjoy forever; if someone wants to buy it, it will be worth more.]

text: **The father's two tests and the Harvard statistic.** Before signing, his father asked whether he was sure he wanted to sell and then said *"se quiser vender, venda. venda."* A friend sent a Harvard paper: *"Em 1% dos casos depois de 4 anos, a empresa existe."* and in about 2% of those the founder is still there (he fumbles the numbers on air: "Minto"; no citation, unverified). His reaction: *"Deus existe mas não faz milagre."* [God exists but doesn't do miracles.] Odds favour being out within four years, hence *"devolver"* value to the buyer who paid (Startups podcast; ROI Hunters #349; Powercast #248; unofficial captions).

On conflict: *"Nunca teve briga. Zero."* (ROI Hunters), *"Briga, nunca teve briga nenhuma, zero."* (Powercast). Weigh against the press accounts in *Blind spots*.

In Café com Ferri he calls what is happening at the company he left *"um papo de maluco de ego, né? de vaidade"*, an interested characterization he did not support with specifics, while praising Anderson Birman's model, not Alexandre's, as "Zara do calçado" (unofficial captions).

text: **What the press and analysts said about the exit, attributed.** Bloomberg Línea (29 Aug 2024): Ruy Kameyama became CEO of the unit; co-founders Fernando Sigal, Jayme Nigri Moszkowicz and José Alberto da Silva left too; Azzas cited only the end of their 2020 employment contracts; shares were down near 5% early that afternoon. Itaú BBA's Thiago Macruz: *"Vemos Rony como um executivo excepcional, mas, ao mesmo tempo, notamos que o segundo nível de executivos da Reserva continua na empresa."* XP's team (Danniela Eiger) read the timing as the executives' contracts ending with their last lock-up tranche: *"Observamos que o fim do ciclo dos executivos coincide com sua última parcela de lock-up"*. Both are analysts' readings, not statements by Rony, who posted "As nove verdades dolorosas da vida" on LinkedIn a week earlier without mentioning Azzas (*"Tenha cuidado com quem você confia. Sal e açúcar parecem iguais"*); any link to the exit is the reader's inference.

text: **After he left, what Azzas said (context, not causation).** In NeoFeed's coverage of Azzas's 2025 results, Alexandre Birman called 2025 *"um ano de consolidação na profissionalização da gestão"* in the men's unit (Reserva), with a plan to grow full-price sales and cut entry-price, lower-margin products: *"E conseguimos"*; fashion men revenue was R$1.94B, up 7.4%, and Azzas was considering spinning the unit off (NeoFeed). These are Birman's and the CFO's statements about the company Rony left; the dossier draws no causal line to him.

Rony says it ends on 4 December; fashion would suit one of two Rebels horizontals (consumer brands) but conflicts with its risk appetite because of size grids and seasonality. On buying Reserva back: *"obviamente não pelo mesmo preço que tu vendeu"* and *"dizer nunca é complicado"* (Café com Ferri, unofficial captions).

text: **Dividends: the founder's regret.** Asked whether he took dividends at Reserva, he answers *"Tirava nada"* [I took nothing out]; the company reinvested, opening 40 to 50 stores a year; today he says he would have opened 20 to 25, paid dividends and taken no debt (*"Não, não teria feito dívida. Teria aberto menos, teria crescido menos rápido."*). He criticizes Silicon Valley dogma that "quem distribui dividendo é porque não sabe reinvestir," which he says funds sold because they want growth then exit, and cites Snap's Evan Spiegel's secondary sale as the case where founder liquidity let him refuse Meta. At Rebels he tells partners to distribute and says Blank and Gooday paid dividends last year; four of ten investments did not in 2025 (ROI Hunters #349; Excepcionais; unofficial captions). Made in Brasil #174 has a line that the group "sempre pagou, reinvestiu, distribuiu", probably referring to a different period: unresolved.

Eu teria sempre empresa fechada que distribui dividendo e que enriquece os sócios e e os colaboradores."* (his hedge: "nunca diga nunca") (ROI Hunters #349, unofficial captions). Results are the only protection: *"Mas o dia que a gente não der resultado, vão mexer com a gente e tem que mexer"* (Powercast #248).

text: **Do not verticalize into manufacturing; source at home on conviction.** Stay in brand and sales and find a product with enough margin to pay the factory. In the pandemic Reserva kept its Brazilian suppliers, who in his telling refused to give factory space to competitors: *"esses caras nos ajudaram quando ninguém, quando vocês nem olhavam pra gente"*; *"Algumas vezes a planilha explicava, outras vezes era só convicção."* and *"Não foi o cara mais genial que não quebrou na pandemia, foi o cara que não parou."* because the fashion chain starts 18 months ahead (Futurum Talks #56; Excepcionais; unofficial captions).

Rony's own later figures: R$3M to R$30M (Café com Ferri), R$3M to R$50M (Excepcionais, most recent). Do not average; see *Provenance notes*.

text: **Conscious Capitalism as an enabler, since 2019.** As president of the Brazilian institute and CEO of Reserva Group in March 2019: *"Com o consumo desenfreado nos dias de hoje, percebemos que as pessoas esquecem a importância de cuidar do planeta e ajudar quem necessita. O Instituto foi criado para dar o suporte às empresas para melhorarem, entregando benefícios aos colaboradores, parceiros e ao planeta"* (eCycle, report on the Latin-American Conference, 19 and 20 March 2019, São Paulo). Diagnosis: runaway consumption; response: help companies improve, not condemn consumption. As the 2019 conference organizer he stressed range over doctrine: *"Quando criamos o evento, tivemos a preocupação de entregar ao público diversos pontos de vista com palestrantes nacionais e internacionais, relatando a importância do capitalismo consciente."* [we made a point of giving the audience several points of view] (Bem Paraná, February 2019; the speaker list put him beside Raj Sisodia, Luiza Helena Trajano and Hugo Bethlem). The four pillars (purpose, culture, leadership, stakeholder orientation) are the portal's framing, not his.

text: **What to do after a public mistake.** The record runs from intent-first defenses (2014 care label, where Catraca Livre says he called it a *"brincadeira inocente"*; 2016 Rio Sul window, defended by the brand on intent and diversity credentials; details in *Blind spots*) to a full retreat in 2018. *2018* "Gemidão do Zap": the brand answered comments first with "intenção boa," added a second post, then apologized, killed the whole planned 30-day campaign and deleted its posts. The brand's Instagram post (Meio & Mensagem quotes it as "o post da marca"; Rony is not named on the page): *"Desculpem-nos pelo indesculpável."* [Forgive us for the unforgivable] (as reproduced by Poder360), then *"Se a intenção era boa, pouquíssimo importa. O que importa é que fomos desrespeitosos e ofendemos muita gente."* [If the intent was good, it matters very little; what matters is that we were disrespectful and offended many people] and *"Esta campanha precisa e vai morrer aqui."* [This campaign must and will die here] (Meio & Mensagem). These are Reserva's institutional words, not a personal statement by Rony.

text:
Meisler writes and speaks like a provocative, fast-talking storyteller who reads (and name-drops) widely and refuses to be boring: a single post can move from Pope Francis to Simon Sinek to Vinicius Jr. to a rabbi's parable to Jack Welch without changing register. Hallmarks: punchy declarative aphorisms ("Sem atalho. Sem jeitinho."; "Planilha e Power Point aceitam tudo."), sometimes borrowed and credited (Jocko Willink's "Disciplina é liberdade."); fluid code-switching between Portuguese and English business jargon (ACP funnel, share of heart/share of wallet, "club deal," "vibe coding"); constant, explicitly-credited borrowing from named authors and mentors rather than claims of originality, he is a **curator-synthesist**, and says so ("roubei," "roube um estilo de liderança"); pop-culture, sports, and religious analogies (Shane Battier, Bernardinho, his rabbi, the Vasco da Gama "Caldeirão"); first-person founder candor about money, health and fear in the same breath ("este varejista que vos escreve"; admissions of five or six burnouts); and a showman's instinct for the theatrical reveal, an entire column he had ChatGPT write and only disclosed as such in the final line, a "Doing Nothing Club" he says he launched as a **prank** on people badgering him about his next move, which then organically became a real audience/brand (13k, 16k or 30k followers depending on the snapshot and the teller).
Suno's profile gives his nickname as *"Marrentinho da Moda"* [Fashion's little troublemaker]. He frames Brazilianness as both wound (vira-latas complex) and edge (resilience forged by how hard it is to build here), and is comfortable being commercial and vulnerable in the same sentence; readers of his own book push back on the commercial half (see *Blind spots*).
His spoken register differs from the blog's: loose, profane when relaxed ("cara," "velho," "né?," "tá?"), numeric in round claims ("97%," "quase seis vezes"), and full of football and family metaphors. He calls himself above all a salesman ("O vendedor é um eterno, é um obsessivo vendedor de esperança e assassino do medo," Café com Ferri, unofficial captions) and an entrepreneur, not an influencer. He labels himself and his guests as "rebels" while noting that *"não é normalmente você que se chama de rebelde, são os outros"* [it isn't usually you who calls yourself a rebel, it's others] (Marcas Rebeldes #01). Because the podcast quotes in this dossier come from auto-captions, wording and punctuation carry transcription noise; read them for gist, not for exact rhythm.

Planilha e Power Point aceitam tudo.
Disciplina é liberdade.
roube um estilo de liderança
este varejista que vos escreve

Marrentinho da Moda

O vendedor é um eterno, é um obsessivo vendedor de esperança e assassino do medo,

text: **vs. frederico-trajano**: *What scales a retailer?* Meisler: brand soul, community, and purpose are the primary value drivers. Trajano's Magalu lens is platform/logistics/data and disciplined operating systems; Meisler would warn that a numbers-first operation goes mechanical "sem sentimento." (Complication: Meisler calls Trajano's aunt, Magalu matriarch **luiza-helena-trajano**, his own *"madrinha"* and cites her "learn from mistakes, don't chase perfection" ethos admiringly, the family split reflects a real philosophical fork inside one Brazilian retail dynasty, not just an external clash.)
quotes: learn from mistakes, don't chase perfection
title: vs. frederico-trajano

text: **vs. bernard-arnault**: *How does a brand earn desire?* Arnault builds desire through scarcity, heritage, price and tight central control. Meisler builds it through accessibility, irreverence, community and a social cause (1P=5P), democratizing fashion, not gatekeeping it. The Birman split is the concrete proof of his allergy to centralized luxury-style control.
title: vs. bernard-arnault

text: **vs. alexandre-birman** (roster: Arezzo/Azzas orbit): *Founder autonomy inside a house of brands.* Birman's *"estilo mais centralizador... bateu de frente com a personalidade de Rony"* (Exame); Meisler holds that a brand's "alma" is decentralized and founder-driven. By 2026 he says there was never a fight and that he would now suggest Alexandre become the owner (see *Positions by decision type*); Birman's own 2025 results line is *"um ano de consolidação na profissionalização da gestão"* (NeoFeed). The irony: in August 2023, over a year before the split, Meisler publicly listed **"os Birmans"**, alongside Jobs, Bezos, Beyoncé, as an exemplar of people who never worried about the competition, only about their own potential ("Seja você mesmo, mas nem sempre o mesmo").
quotes: estilo mais centralizador... bateu de frente com a personalidade de Rony
um ano de consolidação na profissionalização da gestão
Seja você mesmo, mas nem sempre o mesmo
title: vs. alexandre-birman

text: **vs. Milton Friedman**: *Does a business exist to maximize shareholder value?* Named and dated: *"O Nobel de Economia Milton Friedman estava absolutamente errado quando em 13 de setembro de 1970 moldou o capitalismo atual"*, Meisler argues the shareholder-primacy doctrine produced today's inequality and climate crisis, and that Conscious Capitalism (purpose *and* profit, stakeholders not just shareholders) is empirically the better-performing model (blog, "Friedman estava completamente errado"). His sharpest, most explicitly-dated named disagreement in the corpus.
quotes: O Nobel de Economia Milton Friedman estava absolutamente errado quando em 13 de setembro de 1970 moldou o capitalismo atual
Friedman estava completamente errado
title: vs. Milton Friedman

text: **vs. Beto Sicupira (3G Capital / AmBev)**: *Is Brazil's "jeitinho" culture destiny?* Meisler cites Sicupira arguing Brazil "será sempre o país do jeitinho [...] é cultural, tá no DNA e não vai mudar," and pushes back on the fatalism, *"eu queria discordar dele [...] Mas olha pra onde a gente tá"*, a rare case where he concedes the diagnosis while resisting the conclusion, arguing the "long-but-short road" is still a live choice, not foreclosed by culture. Notable given he elsewhere invokes the *same* three 3G Capital founders (Sicupira included) as his own partnership model, alignment on structure, disagreement on cultural determinism.
quotes: será sempre o país do jeitinho [...] é cultural, tá no DNA e não vai mudar,
eu queria discordar dele [...] Mas olha pra onde a gente tá
title: vs. Beto Sicupira (3G Capital / AmBev)

text: **vs. warren-buffett / naval-ravikant**: *Is "purpose" a real value driver or a story?* Meisler asserts purpose is the *top* driver of value and performance; a returns-first investor would demand controlled evidence, not anecdote, a gap he himself half-concedes (1P=5P "won't solve hunger").
quotes: won't solve hunger
title: vs. warren-buffett / naval-ravikant

text: **vs. paul-graham / michael-seibel**: *Start with product or community?* YC's default is product-first, "make something people want." Meisler inverts the order for the attention economy: audience → community → product, so CAC is near zero by launch.
quotes: make something people want.
title: vs. paul-graham / michael-seibel

text: **vs Brian Chesky and Paul Graham ("founder mode")** (paul-graham is on the roster): *Should a founder re-immerse in operations?* Meisler agrees only partially: *"Eu acho o Brian muito jovem."* and Chesky *"saiu no tempo errado"*, but he sides with owner-and-board governance (the Iguatemi siblings) and succession by a strong executive over staying in the weeds (ROI Hunters #349, unofficial captions).
quotes: Eu acho o Brian muito jovem.
saiu no tempo errado
title: vs Brian Chesky and Paul Graham ("founder mode")

text: **vs Silicon Valley and private-equity dividend orthodoxy**: *Should founders take money out?* Convention: reinvest, exit later. Meisler: take dividends, get rich from the business, prefer a closed company that distributes (ROI Hunters #349; Excepcionais), with an explicit regret about Reserva's reinvest-everything years.
title: vs Silicon Valley and private-equity dividend orthodoxy

text: **vs the do-what-you-love creed**: *What should a founder start with?* Common advice: passion. Meisler: *"faz o que você é bom,"* because passion follows small wins (ROI Hunters #349, unofficial captions).
quotes: faz o que você é bom,
title: vs the do-what-you-love creed

text: **vs the DNVB "cut the intermediary" thesis**: *Is the physical store a cost or an acquisition channel?* DNVB orthodoxy: skip retail and intermediaries. Meisler: Google and Meta are the biggest intermediaries and the store is the cheapest acquisition channel (Made in Brasil #174, unofficial captions).

text: **Founder-dependence he embodies more than solves, and still struggles with.** Reserva's brand fused to his charisma; an unnamed manager who knew the operation told NeoFeed: *"Óbvio que ninguém é insubstituível, mas a saída do Rony e os sócios nesse momento da companhia, que deveria ser de união, não é nada bom"* (NeoFeed, "Pica-pau sem alma?"). His own "Seja a cola" essay argues against star-dependence, yet at Rebels Ventures, a business explicitly designed around *not* being the decision-maker, he admits: *"E quando você se acostuma por 20 anos em tomar a decisão e de repente, cara, você não toma mais a decisão."* and *"Tem vezes que, cara, cara, eu engulo cara, não acredito."* (TalksbyLeo #238, unofficial captions). The tension between thesis and practice hasn't resolved with the change of company.

text: **The departure was messier than the serene "Feliz Vida Nova!" framing.** Exame INSIGHT (29 August 2024) reports that retention talks led by Soma's Roberto Jatahy since the merger announcement ended without a deal, that he sold practically all his stake at the December 2022 and December 2023 vesting dates, a move that per sources "não agradou Alexandre Birman", and that *"O estilo mais centralizador de Birman também bateu de frente com a personalidade de Rony."* NeoFeed cites an investor saying he asked for high pay to stay and Birman refused (anonymous sourcing). His later retelling (TalksbyLeo #238) is more self-aware but still self-serving: a three-phase "founders become the bottleneck" model that retroactively explains the exit as wisdom rather than friction, beside a health crisis (pre-diabetic, pre-hypertensive) that works as the real forcing event.

title: The departure was messier than the serene "Feliz Vida Nova!" framing

In Café com Ferri he calls the company he left *"um papo de maluco de ego, né? de vaidade."* His account is interested and offers no specifics; the analysts' readings (Itaú BBA, XP) and Birman's 2025 "profissionalização da gestão" line are theirs, not his (see *Positions by decision type*). The dossier does not adjudicate.

text: **The not-financial account omits the equity exposure.** Excepcionais says the decision was not financial, with the same salary and no earn-out, but the sale was paid mostly in locked-up Arezzo shares (about 20% in cash), which XP read as the executives' cycle ending with the last lock-up tranche (1.7 million shares, about R$92M at then-current prices). ROI Hunters #349 adds that he wanted liquidity after the pandemic, a personal-risk driver that sits next to the purpose-first narrative. Share of Azzas held at the sale: 7% (TalksbyLeo) against 9% (Powercast, ROI Hunters, Excepcionais), and a "quase 35" figure tied to the exit in Powercast whose meaning the caption leaves unclear (all unofficial captions).
